summary: Recent crime data from Boise State University indicates a concerning uptick in serious incidents, particularly in the categories of sexual offenses and property damage. Notably, there were multiple reports of sexual battery, including cases where victims were unable to consent, alongside incidents of malicious injury to property. The frequency of hit-and-run incidents remains consistent, with several cases reported in the past month, suggesting a potential pattern of reckless behavior in campus parking areas. Comparatively, while some categories, such as narcotics violations and alcohol-related offenses, have seen closures through referrals, the increase in violent crimes warrants heightened attention and proactive measures from campus safety authorities.
